Title: Start 2027 Right: The Annual Home Safe Storage Audit
Caption:

Title: The 70 / 30 Grip Rule: Eliminating Sympathetic Squeeze
Caption:
The 70 / 30 Grip Rule: Eliminating Sympathetic Squeeze

ਸਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿੱਪ ਤਕਨੀਕ — 70% ਸਪੋਰਟ ਹੱਥ ਦਾ ਦਬਾਅ ਅਤੇ 30% ਮੁੱਖ ਹੱਥ ਦਾ ਸੰਤੁਲਨ

Your dominant hand shouldn't death-grip the pistol. Transferring 70% of clamping pressure to your support hand frees your trigger finger to press straight back.

• 70% Support Hand Clamp: Fill the exposed grip panel firmly with your support palm and lock your wrist forward.
• 30% Dominant Hand: Hold like a firm handshake so your index finger hinges independently.
• Empty-Hand Diagnostic: Curl your trigger finger empty-handed — watch if your pinky twitches inward.

Title: Understanding California's FFL03 + COE Credential Process
Caption:
Understanding California's FFL03 + COE Credential Process

ਕੈਲੀਫੋਰਨੀਆ FFL03 (ਫੈਡਰਲ ਕਲੈਕਟਰ ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ) ਅਤੇ COE ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ

An educational overview of the federal Curio & Relic Collector's License (ATF Form 7 CR) paired with California's DOJ Certificate of Eligibility (CFARS).

• Phase 1 — ATF Form 7 CR (FFL03): Individual federal collector license ($30 / 3-year term) + informational copy to local CLEO.
• Phase 2 — CA DOJ COE (CFARS): Apply online via CFARS and complete authorized California Live Scan fingerprinting.
• Annual Renewal & Record-Keeping: Maintain an A&D bound book for any C&R items and renew your CA COE annually.
• Keep Address Current: Notify both ATF and CA DOJ promptly if you move so credentials always match.

Title: Why Counterfeit Tourniquets Fail — Carry CoTCCC Approved Only
Caption:
Why Counterfeit Tourniquets Fail — Carry CoTCCC Approved Only

ਨਕਲੀ ਟੂਰਨੀਕੇਟ ਐਮਰਜੈਂਸੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਟੁੱਟ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ — ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਅਸਲੀ CoTCCC ਮਾਨਤਾ-ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਵਰਤੋ

Generic look-alike tourniquets often bend or snap their windlass rod under real arterial pressure. Inspect your range bag IFAK today.

• Authentic CoTCCC Brands: Choose proven brands: CAT Gen 7 (North American Rescue), SOFTT-W, or SAM XT.
• Stage Out of Plastic Wrapper: Remove factory shrink-wrap before packing so it deploys one-handed in seconds.
• Inspect Windlass & Time Strap: Verify rigid composite/aluminum windlass, sharp stitching, and intact white time strap.
• Take Hands-On Training: Enroll in an accredited ACS Stop the Bleed® or Red Cross first-aid course.

Title: 3 Dangerous Firearm Safety Myths (English & Gurmukhi)
Caption:
3 Dangerous Firearm Safety Myths (English & Gurmukhi)

ਗਲਤ ਧਾਰਨਾ: 'ਮੈਗਜ਼ੀਨ ਕੱਢ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਬੰਦੂਕ ਖਾਲੀ ਹੈ।' — ਸੱਚਾਈ: ਚੈਂਬਰ ਦੀ ਖੁਦ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੋ!

Preventable negligent discharges almost always begin with a false assumption. Share these three myth-busters with every new learner.

• Myth 1: Magazine Out = Empty: Reality: A live cartridge can remain inside the chamber. Visually & physically inspect.
• Myth 2: Mechanical Safety = Safe: Reality: Safeties are mechanical devices that can fail — never rely on them over muzzle discipline.
• Myth 3: High Shelf = Childproof: Reality: Kids climb. Only a CA DOJ-certified lockbox, safe, or cable lock secures a home.

Title: Understanding Handgun Ergonomics: Grip Height, Length & Fit
Caption:
Understanding Handgun Ergonomics: Grip Height, Length & Fit

ਹੈਂਡਗੰਨ ਸਾਈਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਗ੍ਰਿੱਪ ਫਿੱਟ ਦੀ ਵਿਗਿਆਨਕ ਤੁਲਨਾ — 1:1 ਸਕੇਲ ਗਾਈਡ

Title: Range PPE Essentials: Eyes, Double Ears & Lead Hygiene
Caption:
Range PPE Essentials: Eyes, Double Ears & Lead Hygiene

ਰੇਂਜ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ — ਅੱਖਾਂ (ANSI Z87.1), ਕੰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਲੈੱਡ (Lead) ਤੋਂ ਸਫ਼ਾਈ

Hearing damage is permanent and lead residue transfers to cars and homes. Build a rock-solid personal protection routine for every range trip.

• ANSI Z87.1 Eye Protection: Always wear impact-rated wrap-around eyewear to shield against brass and debris.
• Double Up Hearing Protection: Pair foam earplugs under 30+ dB earmuffs — especially at indoor ranges.
• Cold Water + Lead-Removing Soap: Wash hands and face with COLD water (hot water opens pores) before eating or driving.
• Dedicated Range Shoes & Clothing: Change shoes before entering homes with crawling toddlers or infants.

Title: How to Legally Transport Firearms in Your Vehicle in California
Caption:
How to Legally Transport Firearms in Your Vehicle in California

ਕੈਲੀਫੋਰਨੀਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਰ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਲਿਜਾਣ ਦੇ ਨਿਯਮ

Heading to the range? One mistake in your car — like using the glovebox or leaving a loaded magazine inserted — can violate California law.

• 100% Unloaded: Verify chamber empty and no loaded magazine inserted in the firearm.
• Locked Container or Trunk: Place handguns in a fully enclosed locked container or inside a separate locked trunk.
• NEVER Glovebox or Console: CA PC § 16850 explicitly excludes utility compartments, gloveboxes, and center consoles.
• Direct Destination Rule: Keep transport direct to/from lawful destinations (range, home, FFL) and never leave unattended.

Title: Two Proven Dry-Fire Drills to Fix Trigger Flinch at Home
Caption:

• Drill 2: The 2-Inch Wall Drill: Stand 2 inches from a blank wall and focus 100% on keeping the front sight completely still.
• 10 Minutes Daily: Short, deliberate, zero-flinch dry-fire sessions outperform rushing boxes of ammo.

Title: May Is Stop the Bleed Month: 3 Life-Saving Steps Everyone Should Know
Caption:
May Is Stop the Bleed Month: 3 Life-Saving Steps Everyone Should Know

ਮਈ 'ਸਟਾਪ ਦ ਬਲੀਡ' ਮਹੀਨਾ — ਖੂਨ ਵਹਿਣਾ ਰੋਕਣ ਦੇ ੩ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਕਦਮ ਸਿੱਖੋ

Severe bleeding is the #1 preventable cause of death after trauma — whether at a shooting range, highway crash, or community event.

• 1. Ensure Safety & Call 911: Call 'CEASE FIRE!' or secure the scene, then dial 911 immediately with exact location.
• 2. Find the Bleeding Source: Cut or move clothing to locate bright red arterial spurting or pooling blood.
• 3. Compress (Pressure / TQ): Apply a CoTCCC tourniquet 2–3" above limb wounds, or pack junctional wounds & hold firm pressure.
• Get Certified Hands-On: Find an official ACS Stop the Bleed® class near you & study free at sikhrpa.org/trauma-safety.html.

Title: Summer Outdoor Shooting in California: Fire Restrictions & Backstops
Caption:
Summer Outdoor Shooting in California: Fire Restrictions & Backstops

ਗਰਮੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਊਟਡੋਰ ਰੇਂਜ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ — ਅੱਗ ਦੀਆਂ ਪਾਬੰਦੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਪੱਕੇ ਬੈਕਸਟਾਪ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ

California enters peak wildfire season every June. Check BLM and National Forest fire orders BEFORE driving out, and pack a shovel, water, and extinguisher.

• Never Shoot Steel in Dry Grass: Sparks from bi-metal jackets or steel targets can ignite dry brush in seconds.
• Confirm Solid Earthen Berm: Never shoot toward skylines, rocky ridges (ricochets), or blind hiking trails.
• Pack Out 100% of Trash & Brass: Leave California public lands cleaner than you found them.

Title: Why You Need a Mylar Space Blanket in Your Range IFAK — Even in Summer
Caption:
Why You Need a Mylar Space Blanket in Your Range IFAK — Even in Summer

ਗਰਮੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਖੂਨ ਵਹਿਣ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਰੀਰ ਠੰਢਾ ਪੈ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ — ਐਮਰਜੈਂਸੀ ਸ਼ੀਟ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਰੱਖੋ

Blood loss destroys the body's ability to stay warm. Dropping just 2°F triggers the Trauma Lethal Triad and stops blood from clotting — even on a 95°F California afternoon.

• 1. Hypothermia (<95°F Core): Massive bleeding chills a patient rapidly, even in hot summer air.
• 2. Coagulopathy: Cold blood loses its chemical ability to form life-saving clots.
• 3. Acidosis: Tissue shock lowers blood pH, accelerating life-threatening decline.
• Action: Insulate & Wrap: Slide a mat/jacket under the patient off bare ground and wrap fully in a Mylar foil blanket.

• Primary ID + Form I-551: Bring valid CA Driver's License/ID PLUS your physical unexpired Green Card (especially if 'Federal Limits Apply').
• Handgun Proof of Residency: Current DMV vehicle registration, signed lease, or municipal utility bill matching your license address.
• FSC & 10-Day Wait Apply Equally: Complete the 30-question CA FSC exam and exact 240-hour DROS waiting period.

Title: First Time at a Public Range? Know These 5 Range Commands
Caption:
First Time at a Public Range? Know These 5 Range Commands

ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਸ਼ੂਟਿੰਗ ਰੇਂਜ 'ਤੇ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ? ਇਹ ੫ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਰੇਂਜ ਕਮਾਂਡਾਂ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖੋ

Public shooting ranges run on strict Range Safety Officer (RSO) commands. Knowing them beforehand keeps you calm, respectful, and 100% safe.

• 1. 'CEASE FIRE!': Stop immediately, finger off trigger, unload, lock action open, step behind the yellow/red line.
• 2. 'RANGE IS COLD': ZERO handling of firearms on the bench while anyone is downrange changing targets.
• 3. 'RANGE IS HOT': Eyes and ears ON before approaching the bench; safe firing may begin downrange.
• 4. Case & Uncase at Firing Line Only: Never uncase behind the line — muzzle must point strictly downrange when opening any bag.

Title: Stop Slapping the Trigger: Master Slack Take-Up & Reset
Caption:
Stop Slapping the Trigger: Master Slack Take-Up & Reset

ਟਰਿੱਗਰ ਨੂੰ ਕਦੇ ਝਟਕੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਾ ਛੱਡੋ — ਰੀਸੈੱਟ ਦੀ 'ਟਿਕ' ਆਵਾਜ਼ ਤੱਕ ਹੀ ਉਂਗਲ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਕਰੋ

Slapping the trigger from full forward travel disturbs sight alignment. Riding the tactile reset cuts trigger travel by up to 60% for smoother follow-through.

• Take Up Initial Slack: Smoothly press through light pre-travel until you feel the crisp 'wall' before firing.
• Press Straight Through the Wall: Add smooth rearward pressure using the center pad of your index finger.
• Hold, Then Release to Reset: After firing, ease forward ONLY until you feel/hear the tactile reset click.
• Practice Safely Dry-Fire: Review all 4 neuromuscular drills at sikhrpa.org/shot-diagnosis.html.

Title: 50/200-Yard vs. 100-Yard Rifle Zero: Which Should You Choose?
Caption:
50/200-Yard vs. 100-Yard Rifle Zero: Which Should You Choose?

ਕਾਰਬਾਈਨ ਜ਼ੀਰੋਇੰਗ ਤੁਲਨਾ — 50/200 ਗਜ਼ ਬਨਾਮ 100 ਗਜ਼ ਜ਼ੀਰੋ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ

Understanding where your bullet crosses your optical line of sight eliminates guesswork from close quarters out to 200+ yards.

• 50/200-Yard Practical Zero: Crosses line of sight at 50 yd, rises <2" at ~120 yd, and crosses zero again at 200 yd.
• 100-Yard Precision Zero: Preferred for magnified scopes — trajectory kisses crosshair at 100 yd and drops smoothly after.
• Account for 2.6" Height-Over-Bore: On either zero, close 3–7 yard shots still hit ~1.5"–2.5" below the dot.
• Interactive Click Calculator: Plot your 5-shot group free at sikhrpa.org/zero-optics.html.

Title: The Ball & Dummy Drill: Exposing Recoil Anticipation Instantly
Caption:
The Ball & Dummy Drill: Exposing Recoil Anticipation Instantly

ਬਾਲ ਐਂਡ ਡੰਮੀ ਡ੍ਰਿਲ — ਰੀਕੋਇਲ ਦੇ ਝਟਕੇ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਪਛਾਣਨ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਤਰੀਕਾ

Think you aren't flinching? Have a trusted range partner mix one inert snap cap randomly into your magazine — your sights will tell the exact truth.

• How to Set It Up Safely: A range partner loads 4 live rounds + 1 bright inert snap cap in a secret order.
• Watch the Front Sight on 'Click': When you press on the dummy round, any downward dip exposes subconscious flinching.
• Correct Immediately: Relax your dominant hand to 30%, clamp 70% with support hand, and press straight back.
• Target Standard: Zero muzzle dip when the striker clicks on the inert dummy round.

Title: De-Escalation First: California Brandishing Law (PC § 417) & Sikh Ethics
Caption:
De-Escalation First: California Brandishing Law (PC § 417) & Sikh Ethics

ਗੁੱਸੇ ਜਾਂ ਝਗੜੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਨਾ ਦਿਖਾਓ — ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਅਨੁਸ਼ਾਸਨ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਪਰ

Both California law (PC § 417 & CALCRIM 3470) and the Zafarnama teach the exact same truth: a firearm is NEVER for intimidation, road rage, or personal arguments.

• PC § 417 Brandishing Crime: Displaying or drawing a firearm in a rude, angry, or threatening manner is a serious criminal offense.
• Road Rage & Ego Traps: Walk away, stay inside locked doors, and call 911 — winning an argument is never worth your freedom.
• Zafarnama Ethic of Last Resort: Force is ethically and legally justified ONLY when facing imminent deadly threat after all peaceful avenues fail.

Title: Safe Firearm Cleaning Protocol: Preventing Administrative Accidents
Caption:
Safe Firearm Cleaning Protocol: Preventing Administrative Accidents

ਹਥਿਆਰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਨਿਯਮ — ਅਸਲੀ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ ਕਮਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਰੱਖੋ

A surprisingly large share of home firearm accidents happen during cleaning and reassembly. Follow this strict 5-step safety routine every single time.

• 1. Remove ALL Live Ammo From Room: Never clean a firearm on a table with loaded magazines or loose cartridges nearby.
• 2. Triple-Check Chamber & Magwell: Remove magazine, lock slide open, visually AND physically feel an empty chamber.
• 3. Ventilate & Protect Eyes: Wear safety glasses against spring tension & solvents; work in a well-ventilated area.
• 4. Function Check Safely: Point in a confirmed safe direction during reassembly function checks, then lock immediately.

Title: Pickup Day Ready: Mastering California's Safe Handling Demonstration
Caption:
Pickup Day Ready: Mastering California's Safe Handling Demonstration

ਕੈਲੀਫੋਰਨੀਆ ਸੇਫ ਹੈਂਡਲਿੰਗ ਡੈਮੋ (SHD) — ਡੀਲਰ ਕੋਲ ਪਿਕਅੱਪ ਵਾਲੇ ਦਿਨ ਦੇ ੫ ਕਦਮ

On Day 10 when you return to pick up your firearm, California requires a physical Safe Handling Demonstration using inert dummy rounds. Know the steps ahead of time.

• 1. Safe Muzzle & Finger Off Trigger: Keep barrel pointed downrange/safe direction and index finger straight on the frame.
• 2. Unload & Lock Open: Remove magazine, lock slide/action open, and visually & physically inspect the chamber.
• 3. Load & Chamber Dummy Round: Load the provided inert dummy round, chamber safely, then eject and re-verify clear.
• 4. Apply DOJ Locking Device: Install the CA DOJ-approved cable lock cleanly through the open action.

Title: Chest Seals 101: Always Roll & Check the Back for an Exit Wound
Caption:
Chest Seals 101: Always Roll & Check the Back for an Exit Wound

ਛਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮ 'ਤੇ ਵੈਂਟਡ ਚੈਸਟ ਸੀਲ — ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਪਿੱਠ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਚੈੱਕ ਕਰੋ!

Torso wounds between the neck and navel can trap air inside the chest cavity. That's why every range IFAK carries a twin-pack of vented chest seals.

• Wipe Blood & Sweat First: Dry the skin around the wound so the hydrogel adhesive seals securely.
• Apply Vented Seal on Exhale: One-way vents let trapped air escape while blocking outside air from entering.
• Always Check the Back!: Roll the patient carefully and physically check for an exit wound — seal it with Seal #2.
• Educational Awareness Only: Always call 911 first & pursue accredited ACS Stop the Bleed® training.

Title: Reading Your Target: What High-Right, 6:00 Low & 9:00 Left Mean
Caption:
Reading Your Target: What High-Right, 6:00 Low & 9:00 Left Mean

ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਗਲਤੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ — 8-ਸੈਕਟਰ ਟਾਰਗੈੱਟ ਡਾਇਲ ਗਾਈਡ

While 7:00–8:00 Low-Left is the #1 pattern, every clock sector on your target reveals a specific biomechanical habit you can fix cleanly.

• 6:00 Straight Low: Breaking both wrists downward or dropping your head right before ignition.
• 9:00 Straight Left (Too Little Finger): Pressing with only the extreme fingertip pushes the frame sideways like a wedge.
• 1:00–2:00 High-Right (Heeling): Shoving the heel of your palm forward into the backstrap as the shot breaks.

Title: Still Carrying a 'Federal Limits Apply' CA License? Know the Rule
Caption:
Still Carrying a 'Federal Limits Apply' CA License? Know the Rule

ਜੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ CA ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ 'ਤੇ 'Federal Limits Apply' ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਪਾਸਪੋਰਟ ਜਾਂ ਗ੍ਰੀਨ ਕਾਰਡ ਨਾਲ ਰੱਖੋ

Title: The Golden Rule of Optic Turrets: Arrows Always Move Bullet Impact (POI)
Caption:
The Golden Rule of Optic Turrets: Arrows Always Move Bullet Impact (POI)

ਓਪਟਿਕ ਡਾਇਲ ਦਾ ਸੁਨਹਿਰੀ ਨਿਯਮ — UP ਅਤੇ R ਤੀਰ ਗੋਲੀ ਦੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ (POI) ਨੂੰ ਹਿਲਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ

Forget twisting dials backwards at the bench. Remember one rule: if your 5-shot group center hits LOW and LEFT, dial UP and RIGHT!

• Always Shoot a 3–5 Shot Group: Never turn turrets after a single shot — measure the group centroid (MPI).
• Hitting LOW? Dial UP: Turn top elevation turret in the direction marked 'UP' to raise impacts.
• Hitting LEFT? Dial R (RIGHT): Turn side windage turret toward 'R' to shift impacts right toward center.
• Zero Math Required: Plot your target hits free at sikhrpa.org/zero-optics.html.
